PROJECTS

Hoot Mobile Application
Flutter • Dart • REST APIs • Speech-to-Text (STT) • Text-to-Speech (TTS) • AI Integration

Hoot is a voice-first English communication app that helps learners build speaking fluency and confidence through guided conversation practice. Contributed to the Flutter codebase using Clean Architecture and modular, scalable coding practices, with REST API integration for backend communication. Implemented the Speech-to-Text (STT) and Text-to-Speech (TTS) pipeline that powers spoken prompts, pronunciation feedback, and real-time voice interaction, along with personalized learning flows, progress tracking, and gamification. Published on the Google Play Store and Apple App Store with 10K+ downloads.

Features: Voice-First Interaction • STT/TTS Implementation • Clean Architecture • REST API Integration • Personalized Learning • Progress Tracking • Gamification • Cross-platform Deployment • 10K+ Downloads
MYNA Mobile Application
Flutter • REST APIs • AI Integration • Speech-to-Text (STT) • Text-to-Speech (TTS)

Myna is an AI-powered English learning and placement preparation platform designed to improve users’ communication, speaking, and interview skills through interactive and personalized learning. Developed a production-ready cross-platform application using Flutter and Dart, following Clean Architecture, modular design, and scalable coding practices. Integrated REST APIs, AI-powered Speech-to-Text (STT), and Text-to-Speech (TTS) to deliver interactive communication and personalized learning experiences, along with placement preparation, assessments, performance analytics, progress tracking, and gamification. Successfully deployed on the Google Play Store and Apple App Store, achieving 1K+ downloads.

Features: Clean Architecture • REST API Integration • AI-powered STT/TTS • Personalized Learning • Assessments • Performance Analytics • Gamification • Cross-platform Deployment • 1K+ Downloads
TAG Mobile Application
